description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* Western Lake Front with Private Dock* Quick Walk to Grayton Dunes Beach Access* 4 Bikes Included* Covered Porch with a Ping Pong Table* Private In-Home Elevator (Add'l Fee Applies)* Close to Grayton Boat Ramp* Prime Location! - Walk to The Red Bar, Zoo Gallery, Chiringos, and Tribe Kelly Surf Pos* Gulf Fishing Charters and Beach Chair attendants available at Grayton Beach* 1.2 Miles from Grayton Beach State Park* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Grayt Oasis, a stunning 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home that comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests. Nestled within the exclusive and newly completed Grayton Landing enclave, this four-story residence offers luxurious living in a serene Old Florida-style setting. Highlights include a private elevator for effortless access between floors and a rooftop observation deck on the fourth floor with breathtaking views.The first floor boasts a spacious veranda overlooking the pool and lake, thoughtfully designed for family entertainment with cozy seating and a ping pong table. The second floor features a king master bedroom, while the third floor offers another king master suite, a guest room with a king bed, and another guest room with a queen bed. The fourth floor houses a delightful bunk room with two twin-over-twin bunk beds. Come experience why the fun never stops at Grayt Oasis!*Elevator is available for an additional fee of $100/night with a $500 minimum. If interested, please reach out to host for further details.Grayton Landing features a lakeside swimming pool with a sun patio, ample pool loungers, a pair of hammocks, an outdoor kitchen with a gas grill for fun cookouts, a wet bar, and a pavilion with tables for poolside dining. It's only a five-minute stroll to the beach, but you can launch a paddleboard from the neighborhood dock and get across the lake to the gulf in no time.The Bed Setup:2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed3rd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed4th Floor:Guest Bedroom: Two Twin BunkbedsArea Attractions:30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. Grayton Beach not only provides you with stunning views, but it also provides you with activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, hiking, and snorkeling - you'll find it all right here!Enjoy this Funky, Free-spirited town where you will find quaint historic cottages next to modern beach homes. It’s an eclectic beach burg with good times, picket fences, funky art, and great dining and shopping. You’ll enjoy the many shopping and dining options such as Grayton Seafood Co, or Trattoria Borago. This is much more than a cool beach town, this location is the best of both worlds, enjoy a quiet relaxing getaway while still having a lot of action-packed activities at your fingertips. The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
